topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder hears 'GEO' and wants to know what it is, where it came from, and which tactics have real evidence behind them before spending time on them.
topic.connection: GEO is the practice AEOeye's audits measure: whether AI engines name a brand for buyer questions. The page ties the original research to measurement and AEOeye's own recommendation benchmark.

assessment: The page defines GEO, reports the original GEO-bench study with its own setup, scores and stated limits (including the rank-dependent effect), separates tactics that held up from those that did not using Google's current documentation, a 2025 follow-up study and a lab manipulation paper, and gives a four-step sequence. It uses AEOeye's recommendation benchmark with its mandatory caveat. It deliberately does not claim GEO guarantees citations, does not compare engines using our unequal samples, and does not present any AEOeye client results.

sources.supports: GEO term and GEO-bench introduced by Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024; up to 40% visibility gain; method scores (Table 1), rank-dependent effect (Table 2), Perplexity check (Table 5), combination result and stated limitations, read from the v3 PDF/HTML text

Google's statement that optimizing for generative AI search is still SEO; query fan-out definition and example; ignore llms.txt, chunking, inauthentic mentions; scaled content abuse; Generative AI performance report in Search Console (page last updated 2026-07-10)
OAI-SearchBot surfaces sites in ChatGPT search; recommendation to allow it; opted-out sites are not shown in ChatGPT search answers but can appear as navigational links
September 2025 comparison finding a systematic bias of AI search toward earned media over brand-owned and social content
900 U.S. adults, March 2025: 8% of visits with an AI summary clicked a result link vs 15% without
Strategic text sequences raised the top-recommendation chance of fictitious coffee machines in a lab setting
Term introduced in the 2023 paper; overlapping terms AEO, LLMO, AIO and AI SEO
